title: aloysia lycioides var. schulziae
intro: Aloysia lycioides var. schulziae, commonly known as Chilean tea tree or Chilean lavender tree, is a plant species native to South America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in relieving stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Aloysia lycioides var. schulziae include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and alleviate digestive issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
